description: This file defines the CognitoSyncClient class, which provides a client interface to interact with the Amazon Cognito Sync service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as bulk publishing, dataset management, and identity pool configuration.

classes.name: CognitoSyncClient
classes.description: Client class extending AwsClient to interact with Amazon Cognito Sync service, providing methods for dataset and identity management.

methods.name: bulkPublish
methods.description: Publishes all data for a specific identity pool to the latest version.

methods.name: deleteDataset
methods.description: Deletes a dataset for the given identity.

methods.name: describeDataset
methods.description: Describes a dataset for the given identity.

methods.name: describeIdentityPoolUsage
methods.description: Provides information about the usage of an identity pool.

methods.name: describeIdentityUsage
methods.description: Provides details about the usage of an identity.

methods.name: getBulkPublishDetails
methods.description: Gets details of the last bulk publish operation.

methods.name: getCognitoEvents
methods.description: Returns the configuration of events that are triggered for the identity pool.

methods.name: getIdentityPoolConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration settings of an identity pool.

methods.name: listDatasets
methods.description: Lists datasets for a given identity.

methods.name: listIdentityPoolUsage
methods.description: Lists usage information for identity pools.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a device for a user.

methods.name: setCognitoEvents
methods.description: Sets event configurations for the identity pool.

methods.name: setIdentityPoolConfiguration
methods.description: Configures settings of the identity pool.

methods.name: subscribeToDataset
methods.description: Subscribes a device to a dataset.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromDataset
methods.description: Unsubscribes a device from a dataset.
